483-792-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-792-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

767-4687-6723.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-4687-6723.description:
Activate A Realm Reborn by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

339-677-4247-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

719-4302-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1661-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

215-4188-6968.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-6968.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

527-3249-5137.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Selvala.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Selvala's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Morphling.
Cast Morphling by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Morphling's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping Havengul Lich.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 8.

261-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1987-4477-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-4477-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3967-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-4676-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3525-4474-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

1350-1870-3609-4153.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 3 or higher.
1350-1870-3609-4153.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. Eternity Vessel enters the battlefield with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Eternity Vessel onto Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
If Magistrate's Scepter has few than three charge counters on it, activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Eternity Vessel from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3 during your next turn if Magistrate's Scepter has three or more charge counters on it. Otherwise, repeat from step 1.
1350-1870-3609-4153.notes: The amount of mana you need to pay each turn varies based off your starting life total. You can also stagger the steps across turns, possibly, to save paying lots of mana in one turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3073-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-4872-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Splash Portal.
813-4872-5895.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

915-2364-5856.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Mana Vault.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1460-2821-4324.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-1460-2821-4324.description:
Animate Candelabra using Workshop Elders
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1170-1645-1770-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-1770-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-864-3563.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-864-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

957-1987-2556-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-2556-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

955-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
955-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

628-4659-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-4659-5490.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrifiicing Pith Driller, adding {C}{C}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3946-4572-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2645-5457.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five creatures with different powers.
2645-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Selvala.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-5457.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

862-3156-3661-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crimson Kobolds.
862-3156-3661-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Crimson Kobolds.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

575-897-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian, adding {C}{C}.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

751-2653-3314-3756.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.

114-1283-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Scholar on the battlefield as Jetfire, Air Guardian.
Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-2034-3490.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

437-4433-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle and Immobilizing Ink attached to Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
437-4433-4474.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Immobilizing Ink by paying {1} and discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

784-3363-4659.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-3363-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The One Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn.
Silas Renn triggers, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring from your graveyard by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Forest you control

515-1636-2050.description:
Activate the Forest with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

471-1802-2060-4120.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, causing all damage that would be dealt this turn to you or to permanents you control to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Gideon's Sacrifice redirects damage to Crawler, which results in at least four +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing at least one +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
